lessons.content: Clear the build cache before running the build; otherwise the linker exits with code 137.
The config key db_url is silently deprecated and returns empty; use db_url_v2.

lessons.situation: deploying via the internal deploy API
lessons.content: Batch deploys need the header X-Batch: true to avoid 429 rate limiting.
The health check reports a crash-loop if the deploy used an empty db_url.
The registry is only reachable over the corporate VPN.
Internal DNS TTL is 300 seconds; wait five minutes before validating record changes.
Set log_level to debug via the config service; a container restart is required to pick it up.
Use deploy --rollback with the previous release id; manual db_url edits are not needed.
Bucket names must be under 40 characters or the provisioner silently truncates them.
Certs come from the internal CA; system trust roots are not sufficient to validate them.
Run migrations before deploying the new version; the service does not auto-migrate.
Acknowledge in PagerDuty within 5 minutes or the page escalates to the whole team.
